title: An idea changes shape / mobile sequence

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study
location.extent: Complete clip; PNG is midpoint poster

slide_intent: Show iteration as visible transformation because a viewer can understand improvement as a process rather than a finished object.
strategic_value: A changing star shape can make Figma’s collaborative creation promise tangible within a short mobile presentation.
demonstration: Within a phone mockup, cursors develop a small star into larger layered shapes while copy explains that an idea’s first shape is not its last; the logo closes the clip.
practical_value: Pair changing geometry with a concise process statement in a mobile campaign.

content_islands.name: Phone frame
content_islands.spec: Keep the white portrait screen inside a phone outline on a dark field.

content_islands.name: Developing shape
content_islands.spec: Expand and reshape the star with several visible colored cursors.

content_islands.name: Copy and signature
content_islands.spec: Build the process statement near the bottom and close with the logo on a white screen against blue-violet.

reference_purposes.Intent: The printed sentence explains that an initial idea continues to change.
reference_purposes.Application: The clip demonstrates the evolving graphic in a phone-format campaign.
reference_purposes.Expression: Layered stars and colored cursors make the editing process visible.
